# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS |
|--------|--------------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Assessment

**Champion holds position** - The v5_latest remains champion due to:
- Superior tuning consistency (min 0.43 vs 0.05)
- Better worst-case MDD (-9.3% vs -11.2%)
- The candidate's extremely low tuning_min (0.05) indicates fragility in certain folds

**System Health**: ✅ Good
- 148 loops completed in ~16 hours
- No INCONCLUSIVE candidates blocking
- ~32 hours remaining in run window

## Recommended Actions

Ready to execute the provided commands:

```bash
# 1. Select best AUB candidates
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Run system candidates  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate next fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- Monitor for candidates that improve **tuning_min** (current weak point at 0.43)
- Fold14 MDD at -9.3% has room for improvement

Proceed with next commands? 🚀
